content.rendered:
Today on Streams of Joy Devotional.

MAJESTIC MANIFESTATIONS

“…Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on,) but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.”
(1 Samuel 9: 27)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

When the word of the Lord concerning Saul was unveiled, he became the King of Israel. Saul’s expansion took him from his father’s house and took him to the throne; it was an Exceeding Expansion that changed his position and gave him a kingdom to rule over; it was an Exceeding Expansion that came with Majestic Manifestations.

Friend, in 2016, you shall walk in Majestic Manifestations. You shall step into higher positions; you’ll sit on your throne and reign in your kingdom; you’ll step into a higher level of influence; you will rise from your setbacks and step into supernatural breakthroughs; God will take you from where you are now to where He wants you to be. God will carve out positions for you.

When Saul became King, his contemporaries became his subjects. God will cause a shift, and people who rub shoulders with you will operate under your influence and leadership. They may not like it, but they won’t have a choice to stop it. As God changes your position, people will serve your destiny.

When Saul’s position changed, everything about him changed: he no longer labored to have what he wanted; several people served him; he sat in a position of authority; he took his place in the limelight; he went ahead of the crowd. God says, as it happened for Saul, so shall it happen for you.

Get set for majestic manifestations. Your position is about to change.

1 Samuel 2: 8 says: “He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory…”

Pray With Me: Lord, this year, I shall step into higher positions, in Jesus’ name!

Follow on Twitter @jerrystreams.

Enjoy A Wonderful Wednesday. Your Exceeding Expansion Has Begun.
